name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
title: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd - 544044 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Housing finance lender with AUM up 29% to Rs 11,044 crore and 30+ DPD down to 4%, but disbursement growth ~11% in Q4 and no supply-side capacity signal; growth guidance trimmed to 25-30%.

guidance.value: 25% to 30% for next 3 years; Rs 30,000 crore AUM by 2030
guidance.quote: Loan growth of 25% to 30% for next 3 years, with a clear goal of reaching Rs. 30,000 crores AUM by 2030.
Maintaining the spreads of more than 6% in the medium term.
Credit cost to remain between 40 to 50 bps.
Branch addition of around 40 to 45 for the year.
this year we will cross 20% of disbursement number which we are quite confident of

guidance.metric: Fixed-rate book funded by variable liabilities
guidance.quote: We are committed to further bring this down to about 5% in FY '27.

prior_guidance_check.quote: AUM growing at 29% year-on-year to Rs. 11,044 crores
OPEX to AUM for the quarter and year is down by 20 basis points year-on-year in line with our guidance.
Thus our margin at bucket level and incremental level are well above our guided level of 6%.

triggers.label: Disbursement growth ~11% in Q4
triggers.quote: I think this quarter it was around 11%.

triggers.label: Growth guide trimmed to 25-30%
triggers.quote: earlier we indicated 30 %-35% maybe over the medium term. Now, we are suggesting that it will be 25% to 30% next year

triggers.label: Login-to-sanction under 50%
triggers.quote: Today, that is less than 50%. It had even bottomed down to the level of 40% to 43%.

triggers.label: BT-out down to 4.5%
triggers.quote: BT-out for the year is down to 4.5%, down by about 80 basis points year-on-year.

triggers.label: 30+ DPD improved to 4%
triggers.quote: 30+ has improved by 100 bps, quarter-on-quarter to 4%.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin lift partly from NPA interest recovery
red_flags.quote: we end up recovering a portion of interest, which we had not accrued earlier.

red_flags.label: Disbursement growth well below AUM growth
red_flags.quote: I think this quarter it was around 11%.

evasions.topic: Disbursement growth Q4 and Q1 outlook
evasions.quote: Please don't allow me to compare between Q4 and how the Q1 has to work on, basically that will give you some kind of forward looking.
So, it is not a point of concern at all.
